title: Learning from Research: Toward Lifelong Agent Harness Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2609.40169v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language agents are expected to solve increasingly complex tasks, creating a growing need for continual improvement. One promising approach is to evolve the agent harness, the software that governs tool use, memory management, and task execution, while keeping the underlying language model fixed. Recent methods automate this process by using a meta coding agent to modify the harness based on execution feedback. However, relying on that agent's existing knowledge and observed failures can restrict exploration and make adaptation reactive. Inspired by how human experts learn from the research literature for new solutions, we introduce ScholarEvolve, a framework that automatically draws on state-of-the-art research to guide harness evolution. ScholarEvolve organizes the harness evolution directions into functional modules and uses topic modeling to identify distinct improvement strategies for each module. translated_title: 从研究中学习：迈向终身智能体框架进化
translated_abstract: 语言智能体被期望解决日益复杂的任务，这产生了对持续改进的不断增长的需求。一种有前景的方法是进化智能体框架——即管理工具使用、记忆管理和任务执行的软件——同时保持底层语言模型固定不变。最近的方法通过使用元编码智能体根据执行反馈来修改框架，从而将这一过程自动化。然而，依赖该智能体的现有知识和观察到的失败可能会限制探索，并使适应变得被动。受人类专家从研究文献中学习新解决方案的启发，我们提出了ScholarEvolve，一个自动借鉴最前沿研究来指导框架进化的框架。ScholarEvolve将框架进化方向组织为功能模块，并使用主题建模为每个模块识别不同的改进策略。它实现这些策略并……
tldr: 提出ScholarEvolve框架，通过自动借鉴前沿研究成果并利用主题建模为各功能模块识别不同的改进策略，实现智能体框架的终身进化，突破了依赖元编码智能体现有知识导致探索受限、适应被动的局限。
en_tdlr: ScholarEvolve automatically draws on state-of-the-art research and uses topic modeling to identify distinct improvement strategies for functional modules, enabling lifelong agent harness evolution that goes beyond the reactive, knowledge-limited adaptation of meta coding agents.
